purpose: In an HSPICE deck `{rv*2}` is no expression (HSPICE delimits expressions with quotes), so a resistor valued by it is refused.

oracle.derivation: Star-Hspice Manual, Release 1998.2, ch. 3 (class.ece.uw.edu/cadta/hspice/chapter_3.pdf) p. 3-19 and p. 3-21: expressions are delimited by single or double quotes; p. 3-30: braces are allowed in node names and changed to square brackets. {rv*2} and {rv} are therefore undefined names, not expressions, and a resistor valued by an undefined name fails.
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
